title: libtpu-pjrt experiment variables
description: Configuration variables for libtpu-rs and multi-framework Cloud TPU PJRT evaluation

LIBTPU_RS_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install libtpu-rs. 'libscript_native' downloads verified GitHub Releases with Cargo fallback, 'system' uses OS package manager, and 'from-source' compiles from Cargo source.

LIBTPU_RS_VERSION.description: Specific version of libtpu-rs to install.

LIBTPU_RS_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading libtpu-rs binary or archive artifacts.

LIBTPU_RS_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying libtpu-rs available remote GitHub releases.

LIBTPU_RS_REPO_DIR.description: Local filesystem path to the libtpu-rs workspace repository.

LIBTPU_RS_GIT_URL.description: Git URL cloned when LIBTPU_RS_REPO_DIR is not already present on disk.

LIBTPU_RS_SO_PATH.description: Explicit override path to a prebuilt libtpu-rs shared library (libtpu.so, libtpu.dylib, or tpu.dll).

LIBTPU_RS_SDK_SO_PATH.description: Explicit override path to a prebuilt libtpu-rs Python SDK extension library (sdk.so, sdk.dylib, or sdk.dll).

LIBTPU_RS_WHEEL_PATH.description: Explicit override path to a prebuilt drop-in PEP 427 libtpu wheel produced by libtpu-rs.

LIBTPU_RS_DIR.description: Resolved versioned installation directory containing libtpu-rs shared libraries and wheels.

LIBTPU_RS_SO.description: Resolved path to the active host-matching libtpu-rs PJRT C-API shared library (libtpu.so, libtpu.dylib, or tpu.dll).

LIBTPU_RS_SDK_SO.description: Resolved path to the active host-matching libtpu-rs SDK extension shared library.

LIBTPU_RS_WHEEL.description: Resolved path to the cached drop-in PEP 427 libtpu wheel (.whl) built or downloaded for libtpu-rs.

LIBTPU_RS_SO_SHA256.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the installed libtpu-rs PJRT shared library.

LIBTPU_RS_ACTIVATE_TPU_LIBRARY_PATH.description: Flag (0 or 1) controlling whether env.sh/env.cmd exports TPU_LIBRARY_PATH pointing at LIBTPU_RS_SO.

LIBTPU_RS_PAPER_DIR.description: Local filesystem path to the libtpu_paper manuscript directory.

LIBTPU_RS_RESULTS_DIR.description: Directory where mechanical E0-E9 JSON artifacts and generated_metrics.tex are emitted.

LIBTPU_RS_CARGO_PROFILE.description: Pinned Cargo release profile identifier enforced under SIGPLAN RULE-6.

LIBTPU_RS_SLIM_FEATURES.description: Cargo feature flags passed when building the slim shared library variant without embedded reflection/CSR catalogs.

LIBTPU_RS_JAX_VERSION.description: Upstream jax and jaxlib version installed into the isolated component virtual environment for Suite E3.

LIBTPU_RS_WARMUP.description: Number of unrecorded warmup runs executed prior to recorded trials.

LIBTPU_RS_TRIALS.description: Number of recorded fresh trials executed per benchmark cell.

LIBTPU_RS_SUBSUITES.description: Comma-separated list of libtpu_paper empirical sub-suites to execute.

LIBTPU_RS_BUILD_PDF.description: Flag (0 or 1) enabling full pdflatex + bibtex compilation and Overfull/Type-3 PK log verification in Suite E8.

LIBTPU_RS_SYNTHETIC_FIXTURES.description: Internal CI test flag (0 or 1) enabling deterministic synthetic repository/manuscript fixtures for smoke testing without hardware or external repos.

LIBTPU_RS_DRY_RUN.description: Flag (0 or 1) logging planned benchmark actions and verifying prerequisites without executing heavy workloads.

LIBTPU_RS_HOST_ARCH.description: Canonical OS/ISA identifier ('linux_x64', 'macos_arm64', or 'windows_x64') tagged onto per-host benchmark artifacts.

LIBTPU_RS_ALLOW_DIRTY.description: Flag (0 or 1) permitting exploratory local development runs on dirty git worktrees prior to final RULE-1 locking.

LIBTPU_PJRT_FRAMEWORKS.description: Comma-separated list of ML frameworks evaluated head-to-head (og vs rs) in Suite E9.

LIBTPU_PJRT_PROVIDERS.description: Comma-separated list of libtpu providers ('og' for upstream Google libtpu, 'rs' for libtpu-rs) evaluated in Suite E9.

LIBTPU_PJRT_JAX_FIND_LINKS.description: Optional override URL for the JAX Cloud TPU wheel index (--find-links) used when provisioning Suite E9 virtualenvs.

LIBTPU_PJRT_TORCH_FIND_LINKS.description: Optional override URL for the PyTorch/torch_xla Cloud TPU wheel index (--find-links) used when provisioning Suite E9 virtualenvs.

LIBTPU_PJRT_TF_FIND_LINKS.description: Optional override URL for the TensorFlow (tensorflow-tpu) Cloud TPU wheel index (--find-links) used when provisioning Suite E9 virtualenvs.

LIBTPU_PJRT_SHM_ROOT.description: RAM-disk directory hosting dedicated twin (-og and -rs) virtualenvs and shared model caches on Cloud TPU VMs.

LIBTPU_PJRT_REQUIRE_HBM.description: Fail-fast guard (0 or 1) requiring non-zero TPU HBM activity and verified /proc/self/maps libtpu.so digest in Suite E9.

LIBTPU_PJRT_LOCAL_EXEC.description: Internal worker flag (0 or 1) indicating Suite E9 is executing directly on a Cloud TPU VM worker host.
